corrections.issue: Human trackway and direct dating overclaim.
corrections.correction: Moreno 2019 reports one ichnite, with an indirect circa 15,600 cal BP contextual estimate. It is not a directly radiocarbon-dated footprint or trackway.

corrections.correction: Use Moreno 2019 and Pérez-Balarezo 2024 for Pilauco; Barberena 2015 investigates Cueva Huenul 1.

corrections.issue: Single older assay presented as secure universal onset.
corrections.correction: The 2015 study explicitly allows an earlier episode or an outlier. Five main-group samples and the older assay remain separate.

corrections.issue: 8.2 ka modeled phase onset confused with a direct painting assay.
corrections.correction: The 8171 BP onset is a model output. The oldest pigment carbon is 6830 ±50 radiocarbon BP; its calibrated range differs between Table 1 and main-text wording. Plant death is a maximum painting age.
DOI 10.1016/j.quaint.2017.07.014 was online in 2017 but published in Quaternary International 473, pp. 261–277, in 2018.
